title: Britain's Lost Generation: George Lamb Investigates | Generation Screwed?
original_title: Britain's Lost Generation: George Lamb Investigates | Generation Screwed?
overview: George Lamb travels across the UK meeting the young people whose voices have been left out of the mainstream media debate. He meets a young mum in Milton Keynes, a nuclear protester in a Scottish peace camp and a housing activist in Brixton.
